To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
The entropy of a wireless camera network can be used as a steganalyst tool for preventing the usage of steganography in the network.

(i) The entropy of a digital camera image is a measure of the amount of information that can be embedded in it, (ii) The entropy of an image is reduced as the image is processed by a camera, (iii) The entropy of the images captured by the cameras of a wireless visual sensor network can be used to prevent the use of stego-cameras in the network, and (iv) A wireless visual sensor network is a good environment to implement preventative steganalysis because

the entropy of the data captured in the network is reduced by means of a new method that we call preventative steganalysis, and that this method is effective in discouraging the use and use of steganographic methods in the network.
